architecture: CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid', cv=3, ensemble='auto') wrapping VotingClassifier(voting='soft') of three pipelines (median impute -> standardise -> classifier): ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=3, class_weight='balanced', random_state=42) + GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=150, max_depth=2, learning_rate=0.05, random_state=42) + RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, min_samples_leaf=3, class_weight='balanced', random_state=42)

intended_use.purpose: SCREENING ONLY -- to flag adults whose connected speech resembles that of people with diagnosed cognitive impairment, so that they can be referred for proper assessment. It does not diagnose, stage, or rule out any condition.
intended_use.users: a family member, nurse or health worker administering the session; results are interpreted by a clinician.
intended_use.input: about one minute of spontaneous description of the validated kitchen scene, in ENGLISH.
intended_use.output: a screening score, not a calibrated clinical probability (see limitations).
out_of_scope: Arabic sessions -- no Arabic-validated threshold exists; the system returns an indicator profile and no score
any picture other than the validated kitchen scene
recordings that fail the quality gate
any use as a diagnostic device

limitations.calibration: Screening score, not a clinical probability: slope 1.289, intercept 0.138, Brier 0.199, largest predicted-vs-observed gap 0.151, confined to the top band (predicted 0.830 vs observed 0.981, n=54). The model understates risk at the top and never overstates it. Slope/intercept re-derived 2026-08-22 by an unpenalised fit of the stored out-of-fold vector; the previously reported 1.276/0.135 came from a penalised fit (results/reconstruction/calibration_slope_resolution.json).
limitations.discrimination: AUC 0.755 combined means that given one impaired and one healthy recording the model ranks them correctly about three times in four. At the deployed threshold overall accuracy is about 67 percent -- roughly one person in three is misclassified.
limitations.mci: Mild cognitive impairment is materially harder (0.629). Trained on Delaware alone the same architecture reaches only 0.547, an interval spanning chance (results/reconstruction/cross_corpus_transfer.json).
limitations.external_test_set_history: Lu is not in this model's training data and entered no decision after the lock of 2026-08-18T17:37, but it was NOT untouched before it: five pre-lock scorings compared training configurations and one informed the decision to add Delaware to the training pool. Both external figures are reported -- 0.821 (clean, Pitt-only model) and 0.853 (this model). docs/LU_EXPOSURE_TIMELINE.md.
limitations.population: Trained on American English clinic recordings. Never validated on Libyan speakers, and never used with a patient in a real clinic.
